eras._note:
Era 1 (1997-2001), the firm's first site. /about/portfolio.html is a hub of sector pages (p-application, p-infrastructure, p-ir, p-isb, p-isc, p-mobile_internet, p-network, p-semiconductor, p-software) plus /about/p-alpha.html, the ALPHABETICAL list of the whole portfolio — one per company, the href pointing at the company's own site (an acquirer's site for exits, marked with a trailing '*'). Some rows close the anchor with
instead of , so the pattern stops at the next tag. Measured 2026-09-06: 46 names (May 1999), 76 (Aug 2001). Undifferentiated by desk: Benchmark Europe opened 2000 and Israel 2001, so late captures of this list can carry a handful of their rows (see decisions.md D2 and the desk overlay).

Era 2 (2001-2005), the 'Power of Teamwork' site. /Benchmark_Portfolio.html is the hub; /Portfolio/Portfolio_By_Location.html is the worldwide list, rendered in three sections (Silicon Valley / Europe / Israel) with no per-row desk attribute, so it carries recall for all three desks and the desk split is read off the desk-specific pages below. Sector pages (/Portfolio/Enterprise_Software.html, Communications_Security, Semiconductor, Mobile_Computing, Consumer_Services, Financial_Services, Networking_Equipment) and /Portfolio/Alpha_List_By_Segment.html are the same union. Measured: 97 links (Oct 2001).

Era 2, Silicon Valley (home) desk page — the positive US attribution for 2001-2005, the window in which /Portfolio/Portfolio_By_Location.html renders all three desks in one undifferentiated alphabetical list despite its name (verified on the 2004 capture). Found while resolving the desk split (decisions.md D4).
Era 2, Europe desk page (Benchmark Europe = Balderton Capital from 2007). Its rows carry lineage 'europe' unless the post-split list re-lists them (decisions.md D2).
Era 2, Israel desk page (Benchmark Israel = Benchmark Israel VC 2007 Ltd, its own ERA). Rows carry lineage 'israel' unless the post-split list re-lists them (decisions.md D3).

Era 3 (2005-2009), the shtml site. /portfolio/worldwide.shtml is the union; /portfolio/{enterprise,communications,semiconductor,mobile,consumer,financial}.shtml are its sector cuts. One non-company target=_blank link sits in the left nav ('View Jobs at Benchmark Capital Companies', hireloop.com) and is filtered by non_company_slugs.
Era 3, Silicon Valley (home) desk page — the positive US attribution for the 2005-2009 window.

Era 4 (2010-2013), the WordPress site. /companies/ ('All Investments') renders one logo card per company: the link carries the CMS slug and the carries the firm's own rendering of the name. THE POST-SPLIT LIST: captured after Balderton (2007) and Benchmark Israel VC 2007 became separate firms, so it is the firm's own claim on its book — Wix and MySQL are on it, Betfair/Bebo/Yoox/Lovefilm are not. Measured: 146 companies (Apr 2011). From 2013 the site is a one-page address card and publishes no list at all.

roster._note: Four people namespaces across eras: /about/<first-name>.html (1997-2001: bill, bob, bruce, andy, kevin, dave, alex, steve, reed, ...), /Silicon_Valley|Europe|Israel/<First_Last>.html (2001-2005), /sv|europe|israel/<slug> (2005-2009) and the 2010-2013 WordPress team pages. /about/vpartners.html lists venture partners and /about/eir.html the EIRs — neither is a general partner and both are filtered. Benchmark publishes no team page at all from 2013, so the current roster is curated from press, the firm's own Form D related persons and the fund vehicles' Section 16 filings, with press-dated tenure windows (decisions.md).

site_api._note: benchmark.com has published no portfolio list since 2013 — the live site is one page carrying two office addresses and a Twitter link (verified 2026-09-06: /portfolio, /companies/, /sitemap.xml, /index.xml and jobs.benchmark.com all 404 or do not resolve). There is no live surface to escalate against, so the 'site listing' evidence class is entirely archival: the file_list source is the last era the firm published (the 2010-2013 /companies/ cards, built by scratch/build-site-list.py out of the wayback parsed years) and carries the firm's own post-split attribution.

edgar._note: Entity-qualified phrases only. Bare 'Benchmark' is the single worst full-text term this project has met: EDGAR carries ~120 BENCHMARK <year>-<series> MORTGAGE TRUST registrants, Benchmark Electronics (NYSE: BHE), Benchmark Bankshares, the Benchmark Plus hedge funds and Benchmark Capital Advisors (a New York 13F filer, decisions.md D5), plus 'benchmark' as a common noun in every rate, index and compensation disclosure ever filed.

desks._note: Desks resolve by CIK and filing address, never by the name pattern alone. The home vehicles file from 2480 Sand Hill Road, Menlo Park (1997-2019) and 2965 Woodside Road, Woodside CA (2019-), the two addresses the firm's own site and its Form Ds carry; the third is 140 New Montgomery Street, San Francisco. Benchmark Europe II/III and the Europe Founders' Funds filed from Menlo Park too (they were the firm's own desk until 2007) and are partitioned out by desk, not by address. 'benchmark capital holdings co' is listed external ONLY as an EDGAR name pattern: the adviser Benchmark Capital Holdings Co. LLC (CRD 160352) is the firm itself and files no EDGAR document; nothing under that name on EDGAR belongs to it. Namesakes verified: Benchmark Capital Advisors (CIK 1352859, 100 Wall Street, New York, a 13F filer whose administrator files from Summit, NJ), Benchmark Capital Corp /BD, Benchmark Electronics (BHE), the ~120 BENCHMARK <year> MORTGAGE TRUST CMBS shells, the Benchmark Plus hedge funds (Tacoma, WA).

profile._note: Benchmark publishes no sector vocabulary of its own since 2013; the 2001-2009 site's own six segments (Enterprise Software & Services, Communications & Security, Semiconductor, Mobile Computing, Consumer Services, Financial Services) describe the 1997-2009 book and not the firm today, so the focus distribution is recomputed off the grind's own tags (§11 'profile without a site'). focus_min_companies ~4.5% of the expected ~230-row base.

shape._note: Defaults kept at kickoff. Benchmark is the most concentrated book any run has met — a five-to-six-partner equal partnership that leads first institutional rounds and has raised roughly one fund every two to three years since 1995 — so the $1B+ share is expected near the guard rather than far below it. A guard that fires is restated in decisions.md against the evidence, not waived.

commoncrawl._note: The /company/<slug>/ namespace existed only 2010-2013, at the very start of Common Crawl's continuous index, and the site has published no company page since. The layer is run once for survivorship correction over that window and is expected to add little; the negative result is recorded rather than assumed (§5).
